prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: ScMoC2 was already predicted in the 2023 institutional primary paper (SG166); no first-discovery claim. A dated exact ScMoC2 superconductivity search found that prediction, not an experimental SC benchmark. The exact source phase and new matched W→Mo mechanism define the reviewed-catalogue candidate. The old paper hull/elastic calculation is separate-method supporting prior and is not silently assigned as a new exact-state measurement.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The original 2023 primary study associates appreciable coupling with an acoustic softening along Gamma-X and places predicted ScMoC2 49 meV/atom above its hull. This is a metastable research route, not equilibrium synthesis certification. Its later exact-source path has no signed negative printed modes and Gamma optical compression is positive; fine force .00823 eV/A and anisotropic stress .363 GPa remain finite-grid stationarity limits.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Coarse/fine SCF both converge; complete source forces/stress, positive Gamma optical compression and no signed negative finite-path value support this model near ambient. All listed q outputs end JOBDONE/response convergence with zero routine errors. This is finite-grid local/metastable evidence, not exhaustive thermodynamic or all-irrep certification.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Replace W by Mo in the frozen ScWC2 analogue. Volume changes −0.342810%, Sc-C nearest distance −0.00476510 A and C-C +0.00726968 A. The same 4x4x4 PH grid with 13 q representatives yields all-ten lambda gains 10.495–13.659%; separate Eli mu=.1 increases 11.083→15.678 K. Tiny geometry changes accompany a chemically different metal response, so this is a coupled cation-construction hypothesis, not a geometry-only strain mechanism.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Test one common-grid acoustic Gamma-X/q-mode response in ScWC2 and ScMoC2, or an equal-volume composition cross-control. Favorable: the bounded Mo advantage persists with finite positive curvature; adverse: stronger softening turns the branch unstable or a competing decomposition route reverses near-ambient feasibility.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
